## Summary of Changes

Describe the proposed changes, the motivations behind them, and how they improve the companion.

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes adhere to the **read-only** and **local-first** principles.
- [ ] Code, comments, errors, and documentation are written in English.
- [ ] No real player save names, credentials, private computer paths, or player snapshots are included.
- [ ] Behavioral regression tests added (`uv run pytest` passes).
- [ ] If changing analysis metrics, explain the game-mechanics basis.
- [ ] If changing the bridge mod, syntax check passed (`luac -p`) and limitations documented.
